entries.instructions.bow: Hold right click to draw; release to fire. Left click: attack / mining swing.
entries.instructions.crossbow: Hold right click to load; right click again to fire. Left click: attack / mining swing.
entries.instructions.fishing_rod: Left click: attack or mine. Right click: cast; right click again to retrieve the hook, hooked entity, or fishing loot.
entries.instructions.flint_and_steel: Left click: attack or mine. Right click: ignite a block face; soul sand and soul soil create soul fire.
entries.instructions.trident: Left click: attack / mining swing. Hold right click for 10 ticks, then release to throw.
entries.instructions.totem_of_undying: Hold it in the selected inventory hand or offhand to survive lethal damage.
entries.instructions.shield: Hold right click to block attacks after the vanilla 0.25 second raise delay. Axes disable blocking for 5 seconds. Left click attacks or mines while lowered.
entries.instructions.name_tag: Rename the tag in a MineMod anvil, then right click a living NPC. Players cannot be named.
entries.instructions.shears: Left click: attack or mine. Right click: shear a ready BMB sheep/Bogged or stop a growing vine head at age 25.
entries.instructions.mace: Primary: attack. Falling more than 1.5 blocks performs a smash attack.
